capabilities: Insert multiple colored badges in chosen order via the editor context menu
Create and save badge presets in the settings page
Adjust a global badge font size ratio and corner roundness per vault
Import presets by pasting existing badge span code
Pick theme or custom HEX colors for badges
disambiguation: Badges are complete HTML span elements, not Markdown syntax, so they rely on Obsidian's native inline HTML rendering and keep their HTML in the note text.
extras: Declared desktop-only; mobile, older browsers without color-mix(), and third-party themes are unverified. Config version 4 cannot be read by plugin versions 0.6.1 and earlier, so the README advises backing up data.json before downgrading. Disabling the plugin leaves HTML in notes; styling can be kept by copying rules into a CSS snippet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert small colored label badges into notes without hand-writing HTML span markup or maintaining CSS snippets.
summary: Editor context-menu tool that inserts colored text badges as HTML spans in notes, with saved presets, HEX colors, span import, and per-vault size and corner settings.
